VM opcode D0 branches through 0x006462 when sequence flag bit0 is clear.
VM opcode D1 branches through 0x006462 when scene gate bit0 is clear.
VM opcode D2 consumes a signed byte operand and stores operand-1 in the profile-request word.
VM opcode CF clears resume state byte 0x67B1 and resume word 0x6764.
VM opcode CC uses operand1-1 as a 16-byte slot index and copies a padded NUL string operand into that slot.

VM opcode CB consumes a tag, byte pair, and padding word, then branches unless the signed pair comparison succeeds.
VM opcode A0 marks query mode, pushes the next script word to the branch stack, and advances the script word cursor.
VM opcode A1 clears query mode and pops the branch stack unless it is already at the base slot.
VM opcode A2 consumes a random modulus and branches when the PRNG result is nonzero.
VM opcode A3 either scans to the zero-word terminator or branches based on an optionally inverted match value.
VM opcode A4 loads the target script offset from the current cursor and clears resume state before returning the target.
VM opcode A5 either branches on a state-array word in query mode or stores the next script word into that slot.
Near strlen variant; pending proof of ES:DI far-pointer argument codegen.
VM opcode A7 consumes a script word and stores it in 0x6770 only while presentation-active bit0 is set.
VM opcode A8 copies a padded NUL string operand into 0x2120 and applies finale plus presentation-request side effects.
VM opcode A9 either replaces the script cursor with the target operand or seeds query mode and branch-stack slot zero.
VM opcode AB consumes a byte value and near pointer operand, then stores the byte through that pointer.
VM opcode AA sets the VM yield flag.
VM opcode AC is an alias of AA and sets the VM yield flag.
Shared B1/B4/B5/B6/BE/BF/C0 handler: reads a record word, resolves an immediate or record-backed RHS, then compares or updates the field.
Shared AE/B0 VM opcode handler: query mode branches on record mask bits, set mode ORs or clears the mask.
VM opcode B7 addresses a high-bit-first record bit and either tests it in query mode or sets/clears it.
Shared B8/B9/BD handler: compares or writes a two-word record field pair and clears a secondary link on matching threshold.
VM opcode C5 matches typed C5 records in query mode; set mode writes a C5 record only for an active related type-0x0200 record and empty destination.
VM opcode C6 matches typed C6 records in query mode; set mode writes a C6 record with the operand and zero tail.
VM opcode C7 matches typed C7 records in query mode; set mode writes a C7 record for an active related record when the destination is empty or C4.
VM opcode C8 matches typed C8 records in query mode; set mode writes an empty C8 record only when the destination is empty.
